description: Export the results of a people search you already built on Apollo.io, past Apollo's own export cap and without consuming Apollo export credits. You must supply the Apollo search URL. Only leads that have a verified email address are delivered, so the count can be lower than the number Apollo displays. Costs $9 per 1,000. Returns a job id: poll job_status, then download.

apollo_url.description: A people search URL copied from Apollo.io, e.g. https://app.apollo.io/#/people?personTitles[]=cto. The URL must carry at least one filter (job title, location, company keywords or employee size); a bare URL is rejected because it would return everything. Filters Evascrape cannot read, such as a saved Apollo persona, are ignored, so the list can come back broader than the Apollo screen showed.

email_verification.description: Extra real-time verification for $5 per 1,000. Default false.

total_records.description: Maximum leads to export. Multiple of 100, minimum 100, maximum 50000.

name: apollo_export
title: Export an Apollo.io search
